recipes.name: Chicken thigh, rice and pepper traybake
recipes.description: Everything cooks in one tray: the rice soaks up the chicken juices while the peppers go soft and sweet.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan).
Cut the peppers and onion into chunky pieces and tip them into a large deep tray with the oil, spices and crushed garlic.
Lay the chicken on top and roast for 15 minutes.
Stir the dry rice into the tray with 700 ml boiling water, cover tightly with foil and roast for 25 minutes, until the rice is tender and the chicken is cooked through.
Rest for 5 minutes, then divide into four boxes.

recipes.name: Turkey mince chilli with kidney beans
recipes.description: A big, thick pot of lean chilli with beans for extra fibre. It tastes better on day two.
steps: Soften the chopped onion and pepper in the oil in a large pan for 5 minutes.
Add the crushed garlic, spices and turkey mince. Break the mince up and cook until there is no pink left.
Tip in the tomatoes and the drained beans, then simmer for 25 minutes, stirring now and then.
While it simmers, cook the rice following the packet.
Divide the chilli and rice between four boxes.

recipes.name: Beef and lentil bolognese
recipes.description: Red lentils stretch a small amount of beef mince into five generous, protein-packed portions.
steps: Fry the chopped onion and grated carrot in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, spices and beef mince and cook until browned.
Stir in the lentils, tomatoes and 400 ml water. Simmer for 30 minutes until the lentils are soft, adding a splash of water if it gets dry.
Cook the pasta following the packet and drain.
Split the sauce and pasta between five boxes.

recipes.name: Chicken tikka-style curry with Greek yoghurt and rice
recipes.description: Yoghurt and curry paste make a creamy, mild curry without any cream.
steps: Dice the chicken and stir it through the yoghurt and curry paste in a bowl. Leave it while you start the sauce.
Soften the chopped onion and crushed garlic in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken with all its marinade and cook for 5 minutes, then pour in the tomatoes and 100 ml water.
Simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through. Cook the rice following the packet.
Divide the curry and rice between four boxes.

recipes.name: Tuna pasta bake
recipes.description: A cheesy, golden bake made almost entirely from the cupboard.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Boil the pasta for 2 minutes less than the packet says, then drain.
Soften the chopped onion and garlic in a pan, add the tomatoes and spices and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir the drained tuna, sweetcorn and pasta into the sauce.
Tip it into a baking dish, scatter over the grated cheese and bake for 15 minutes until golden.
Let it cool a little, then divide into four boxes.

recipes.name: Turkey meatballs in tomato sauce
recipes.description: Lean turkey meatballs, held together with a little bread, simmered in a simple tomato sauce.
steps: Tear the bread into crumbs and mix with the mince, egg, half the garlic and half the spices. Roll into about 24 balls.
Brown the meatballs in the oil for 5 minutes, turning them often.
Add the chopped onion, the rest of the garlic and spices and the tomatoes. Simmer for 20 minutes until the meatballs are cooked through.
Meanwhile cook the pasta following the packet and drain.
Divide the meatballs, sauce and pasta between four boxes.

recipes.name: Egg, ham and spinach muffins
recipes.description: Savoury egg muffins that reheat in a minute. Three muffins make a portion.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan) and brush a 12-hole muffin tin with the oil.
Whisk the eggs with the cottage cheese until mostly smooth.
Chop the ham, thaw the spinach and squeeze out the water. Share the ham, spinach and grated cheese between the 12 holes.
Pour the egg mixture over the top.
Bake for 22 to 25 minutes until set and lightly golden. Cool, then keep three muffins per portion.

recipes.name: Overnight oats with Greek yoghurt and whey
recipes.description: Five jars you assemble in one go on Sunday evening and grab all week.
steps: Spoon 50 g of oats into each of five jars.
Whisk the yoghurt, whey and milk together until smooth.
Pour the mixture evenly over the oats and stir.
Top each jar with 50 g of berries, put the lids on and chill overnight.

recipes.name: Tuna, sweetcorn and cottage cheese jacket potato
recipes.description: A microwave jacket potato with a cool, creamy tuna filling.
steps: Prick the potato all over and microwave for 8 to 10 minutes, turning halfway, until soft.
Drain the tuna and mix it with the cottage cheese and sweetcorn.
Split the potato open and spoon the filling in.

recipes.name: Chicken and veg egg-fried rice
recipes.description: A fast stir-fry built on a pouch of microwave rice.
steps: Slice the chicken thinly and fry it in the oil for 5 minutes until cooked through.
Add the frozen vegetables and cook for 2 minutes.
Push everything to one side, crack the egg into the gap and scramble it.
Add the microwaved rice and the soy sauce and stir-fry for 2 minutes.

recipes.name: Scrambled eggs and beans on toast
recipes.description: A cafe-style breakfast with three eggs for extra staying power.
steps: Heat the beans in a pan or the microwave.
Toast the bread.
Beat the eggs with the milk and scramble gently in the butter, taking the pan off the heat while they are still soft.
Pile the eggs and beans onto the toast.

recipes.name: Greek yoghurt protein pot
recipes.description: Whey stirred into thick yoghurt, topped with fruit and crunch.
steps: Stir the whey into the yoghurt until there are no lumps.
Scatter the berries on top and leave for 5 minutes so they soften.
Sprinkle over the oats.

recipes.name: Chicken and chickpea curry
recipes.description: A hearty curry where chickpeas and spinach bulk out the chicken thighs.
steps: Soften the chopped onion and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the diced chicken and the curry paste and cook for 5 minutes, stirring.
Tip in the tomatoes, the drained chickpeas and 150 ml water. Simmer for 20 minutes, then stir in the spinach for the last 5.
Cook the rice following the packet.
Divide the curry and rice between four boxes.

recipes.name: Turkey and lentil shepherd's pie
recipes.description: Lean turkey and lentils under a cheesy mashed potato lid. Freezes well in portions.
steps: Peel and chop the potatoes, boil for 15 minutes until soft, then mash with the milk.
Meanwhile brown the mince with the chopped onion and grated carrot.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, spices and 300 ml water and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring in the peas at the end.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Spoon the filling into a dish, spread the mash on top and scatter over the grated cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes until golden, then divide into four.

recipes.name: Chicken burrito bowls
recipes.description: Spiced chicken, beans, rice and sweetcorn, topped with a spoonful of yoghurt instead of soured cream.
steps: Cook the rice following the packet.
Slice the chicken and peppers, toss with the spices and fry in the oil for 8 to 10 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Warm the drained beans and sweetcorn in the same pan for 2 minutes.
Share the rice, chicken, peppers, beans and sweetcorn between four boxes.
Add a spoonful of yoghurt to each just before eating.

recipes.name: Spiced chicken wrap
recipes.description: A warm wrap of spiced chicken and peppers with a cool yoghurt sauce.
steps: Slice the chicken and pepper thinly and toss with the spices.
Fry in the oil for 6 to 8 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Warm the wrap, spread on the yoghurt, add the filling and roll it up.

recipes.name: Tuna, chickpea and pepper salad
recipes.description: A no-cook lunch you can throw together in a box.
steps: Drain the tuna, chickpeas and sweetcorn.
Chop the pepper into small pieces.
Mix everything together with the oil and a pinch of salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Banana protein pancakes
recipes.description: Thick, fluffy pancakes made in a blender from oats, egg, banana and whey.
steps: Blend the oats, eggs, whey, banana and milk until smooth.
Heat a non-stick pan with the oil and cook small pancakes for 1 to 2 minutes each side.
Stack them up and eat warm.

recipes.name: Peanut butter protein porridge
recipes.description: Creamy porridge with whey stirred in at the end and a spoon of peanut butter on top.
steps: Microwave the oats and milk in a large bowl for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring halfway.
Let it stand for a minute, then stir in the whey until smooth.
Top with the peanut butter.

recipes.name: Turkey and veg noodle stir-fry
recipes.description: A fast noodle stir-fry with lean turkey mince and frozen vegetables.
steps: Cook the noodles following the packet and drain.
Fry the mince and crushed garlic in the oil for 5 minutes, breaking it up.
Add the frozen vegetables and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Toss in the noodles and soy sauce and stir-fry for 1 more minute.
